text: Now gather your troops, city of troops — a siege has been laid against us. They will strike Israel's ruler on the cheek with a rod.
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, small as you are among Judah's clans, from you will come one who will rule over Israel for me, one whose roots go back to ancient days, to times long past.
So he will hand them over until the time when a woman in labor gives birth; then the rest of his kinsmen will come back to join the people of Israel.

He will take his stand and shepherd his people by the LORD's strength, in the honor of the name of the LORD his God. They will live in safety, for his greatness will extend to the far ends of the earth.
And he himself will be their peace. When the Assyrian marches into our land and tramples our fortresses, we will raise up seven shepherds against him, even eight leaders of the people.
They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, the land of Nimrod at its own gates. He will save us from the Assyrian when he invades our territory and crosses our border.
Then what remains of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew sent from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which wait for no one and do not depend on anyone's help.

And what remains of Jacob will also be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which tramples and tears as it goes, with no one able to rescue.
Your hand will be raised high over your enemies, and all your foes will be cut down.
On that day, declares the LORD, I will remove your horses from among you and destroy your chariots.
I will tear down the cities of your land and knock over every one of your strongholds.
I will remove the tools of sorcery from your hand, and you will no longer have fortune-tellers.
I will destroy your carved idols and your sacred pillars from among you; you will bow down no more to what your own hands have made.
I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you and level your cities to the ground.
And in anger and fury I will take vengeance on the nations that did not listen to me.
